scene_timeline.visual_description: Cody Sabol begins a speed painting on a large black canvas on a stage, starting with broad red strokes for Spider-Man's head and torso.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Epic orchestral version of the Spider-Man theme music begins.
scene_timeline.text_on_screen: Painting Andrew Garfield Spider-Man in 7 minutes‼️

scene_timeline.visual_description: The artist continues layering red paint and gives a quick thumbs-up to the camera while working rapidly.
scene_timeline.audio_description: The music builds in intensity with cinematic percussion.
scene_timeline.text_on_screen: Painted LIVE at a middle school‼️

scene_timeline.visual_description: Cody adds white paint for the iconic large eyes of the Spider-Man mask and begins defining the suit's black webbing.
scene_timeline.text_on_screen: Because I had to teach these kids who the best Spider-Man is‼️

scene_timeline.visual_description: The artist adds blue highlights and background elements to the portrait, refining the muscular structure of the character.
scene_timeline.text_on_screen: Also, shout out to 8th grader Levi who filmed this on my iPhone.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Final details are added to the background and suit texture with rapid, expressive movements.
Cody finishes the painting, steps back to reveal the completed Andrew Garfield Spider-Man portrait, and takes a bow.
scene_timeline.audio_description: The music concludes with a final dramatic note.

parsed_output.overall_summary: Artist Cody Sabol performs a high-speed live painting of Andrew Garfield's Spider-Man on a stage at a middle school. The video is a time-lapse of a 7-minute performance where he uses vibrant red, blue, and white paint on a black canvas to create a dynamic portrait. He claims Andrew Garfield is the 'best Spider-Man' and concludes the video by asking his audience for suggestions on who to paint next.

items.details: Start with a black canvas, block in primary colors (red), add highlights (white), define outlines (black), and finish with background/accent colors (blue).
